kinds.production_unknown: production has no record — cannot verify

actions.guardNote: The route checks every rule again (baseline, dependencies, targets, capacity).

form.description: Define the objective, context and orchestrator. The mission starts as a draft.
form.adminOnly: Only administrators can create or edit missions.
form.required: Enter a name, product or service and orchestrator.
form.saveError: Could not save. Check the details and try again.
form.terminal: This mission is closed and read-only.
form.fixed: Approved context is protected. Submit a change request to modify it.
form.name: Mission name
form.draftHint: Creating a draft does not approve the plan or start execution. Roles, context and criteria are validated before opening.
form.cancelDescription: Mission “{{name}}” will be cancelled. History, documents and evidence will be preserved.
form.invalid: Check the required fields and allowed value ranges.
form.conflict: The mission changed or this update is blocked. Reload the data and check its current state.
form.newProductHint: ForgeHub registers only the name and kind (version 0.1.0). The orchestrator completes the registration and writes the creation documentation in the working directory's docs/ folder; the mission leaves draft only after that.
form.newProductRequired: For a new product or service, enter its name and the working directory.
form.directoryDocsHint: Required for a new product or service: the creation documentation goes in docs/ inside this folder.
form.newProductCheckbox: New product or service (not registered yet)
form.newProductSelected: New product or service, entered below

team.title: Agents by role
team.description: The orchestrator coordinates the plan. Each agent has a role and responsibilities; task assignment and reviewer selection remain in planning.
team.approvalHint: Final acceptance remains with the administrator. A role does not authorize expanding scope or reviewing your own delivery.
team.confirmDescription: Confirm the change to {{name}}’s membership? Mission rules validate permissions.
team.required: Select an agent and describe their responsibilities.
team.contextDescription: Each dispatch includes the task, the approved brief objective, baseline, linked criteria, predecessors, orchestrator, role, responsibilities and working directory. This form does not replace the approved brief. Personal memories, client data and other tasks’ results are excluded.
team.unsaved: Save the role or reset its editor before saving the mission details.

criteria.title: Acceptance criteria
criteria.description: Define the verifiable result and the tasks that must prove it. Criteria lock after the baseline.
criteria.empty: No acceptance criteria have been registered.

acceptance.title: Mission acceptance
acceptance.error: Could not load the acceptance request.
acceptance.missing: The orchestrator has not requested acceptance yet.
acceptance.submitted: Requested by {{name}}. Delivery will be checked again when you decide.
acceptance.reason: Reason for acceptance or requested changes

detail.productPendingBody: The orchestrator must complete the product or service registration and write its creation documentation in {{docs}}. The mission leaves draft only after that.
